subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be supported now as a first-party browser profile driver, routed through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam, or documented as unsupported for stateful Sessions API workflows?
rationale: The fix crosses commercial-service integration scope, browser-control security, credential handling, signed URL redaction, config/schema surface, and session lifecycle ownership, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise First-Party Driver
options.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

options.title: Design Generic Backend Seam
options.body: Keep Browserbase tied to a broader browser backend/plugin API so service-specific drivers can live outside core once registration is available.

options.title: Document Unsupported
options.body: Stop recommending the static Browserbase setup until maintainers are ready to support Sessions API lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Revise First-Party Driver
recommendation.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available history across the browser plugin boundary and runtime profile surfaces implicated by this product decision.
